requirements.title: Business requirements
requirements.building: This screen is being built in Slice 1.
requirements.detailSubtitle: One requirement per process step · created with the step, edited here or in its panel in the function chart
requirements.statusByFreeze: Set by the baseline freeze — not editable here.
requirements.retireBody: {number} is hidden from lists. It can be restored from Show retired.
requirements.noData: No data yet. Add an entity, then tick what the requirement does with it.
requirements.crudHelp: Input and output are derived from CRUD — R is input, C, U and D are output. Ticking one also adds the data to the process step.
requirements.coverageHint: Link function requirements in this requirement's Function requirements section.
requirements.recordLock: If someone else saves first, your save is stopped and you are asked to reload — nothing is overwritten.
requirements.frs.title: Function requirements
requirements.frs.noneToLink: There is no live function requirement left to link. Use New FR to create one.
requirements.frs.newHint: The FR number is assigned when you create it, and it is linked to {br} at once. A solution is optional.
requirements.frs.none: No function requirements are linked to this requirement yet.
requirements.frs.notThisBrError: That solution does not answer this requirement. Add it to this requirement's solutions first.
requirements.frs.unlinkBody: {fr} will no longer be mapped to {br}. The function requirement itself is kept, and you can link it again.
requirements.frs.stale: Someone else changed this link or function requirement. The list has been refreshed — try again.
requirements.frs.warn.fr_solution_outsid: {frs}: its solution now answers none of the requirements it serves. Nothing was changed — choose a fix.
requirements.frs.warn.no_br: {frs}: no longer linked to any business requirement (untraced).
